# Direct static SQLite integration: no dlopen and no process constructor.
if(NOT TARGET LMX::sqlite3)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "sqlite-vec requires the existing LMX::sqlite3 target")
endif()
set(LMX_SQLITE_VEC_SIMD NONE CACHE STRING "sqlite-vec SIMD: NONE (portable default) or AVX (deployment CPU must support AVX)")
set_property(CACHE LMX_SQLITE_VEC_SIMD PROPERTY STRINGS NONE AVX)
string(TOUPPER "${LMX_SQLITE_VEC_SIMD}" _vec_simd)
if(NOT _vec_simd MATCHES "^(NONE|AVX)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "LMX_SQLITE_VEC_SIMD must be NONE or AVX")
endif()
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/C99View.cmake")
set(_vec_view "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/c99-source")
lmx_sqlite_vec_c99_view("${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}/sqlite_vec_amalgamation" "${_vec_view}")
add_library(lmx_sqlite_vec STATIC "${_vec_view}/sqlite-vec.c")
lmx_c99_target(lmx_sqlite_vec)
target_include_directories(lmx_sqlite_vec PUBLIC "${_vec_view}")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_sqlite_vec PUBLIC SQLITE_CORE SQLITE_VEC_STATIC)
target_link_libraries(lmx_sqlite_vec PUBLIC LMX::sqlite3)
if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_sqlite_vec PUBLIC m)
endif()
if(_vec_simd STREQUAL "AVX")
    if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|amd64|AMD64|i[3-6]86|x86)$")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "sqlite-vec AVX profile requires an x86 target")
    endif()
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(lmx_sqlite_vec PRIVATE /arch:AVX)
    elseif(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
        target_compile_options(lmx_sqlite_vec PRIVATE -mavx)
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "No validated AVX flag mapping for this compiler")
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(lmx_sqlite_vec PRIVATE SQLITE_VEC_ENABLE_AVX)
endif()
add_library(LMX::sqlite_vec ALIAS lmx_sqlite_vec)
message(STATUS "LMX sqlite-vec 0.1.9: static explicit registration, SIMD=${_vec_simd}")
if(BUILD_TESTING)
    add_executable(lmx_sqlite_vec_test tests/sqlite_vec.c)
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_sqlite_vec_test)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_sqlite_vec_test PRIVATE LMX::sqlite_vec)
    if(_vec_simd STREQUAL "AVX")
        target_compile_definitions(lmx_sqlite_vec_test PRIVATE LMX_TEST_VEC_AVX=1)
    endif()
    add_test(NAME sqlite_vec.version_knn_dimensions COMMAND lmx_sqlite_vec_test)
    set_tests_properties(sqlite_vec.version_knn_dimensions PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
endif()
